name: UI Gallery
description: A gallery of plugin SDK features: static and advanced tooltips, registered icons, accessible names, menus, context menus, a dynamic submenu, a shortcut, choices, check boxes, radio buttons, field kinds, validation, completion, a rich table with check boxes, row dragging, Export CSV and its own context menu, and an explorer view with a lazy tree (check boxes, dragging, node tooltips, a context menu) and a file tree.

items.title: Open explorer
items.tooltip: Opens the UI Gallery Explorer view: a tree of benches and a file tree.

items.title: Highlight offline boards
items.tooltip: Mutes the other boards in the gallery table.

items.title: Boards
items.tooltip: Filled by the plugin each time it opens.

items.title: Count selected lines
items.tooltip: Shows the count in the UI Gallery status label.

items.title: Describe tab
items.tooltip: Shows the tab in the UI Gallery status label.

items.title: Remove from List
items.tooltip: Removes the selected boards from the table.

items.title: Restore Removed Boards
items.tooltip: Puts the removed boards back into the table.

items.title: Reset Node
items.tooltip: Connects the boards of the clicked or selected nodes again.

items.title: Show Path
items.tooltip: Shows the clicked path in the explorer's status label.
